definition_zh: 喝彩声「好！」；亡命徒；勇敢的（旧义）
definition_en: a shout of approval; also a daring hired fighter, or brave in Italian use
core_image: 剧院里灯光明亮，观众起立高喊「Bravo!」；同一词也可指旧时街头佩剑的打手
scene: 独唱结束，全场起立鼓掌。When the aria ended, someone cried bravo from the balcony.
sceneCN: 这里 bravo 是「喝彩声」（第 1 个义项：对演出的赞美呼喊）；句意是咏叹调结束时，楼座有人高喊「好！」。

pos.zh: 字母B的代称（北约音标字母）

derivatives.zh: 由同根构成，义为「虚张声势」
同根形容词，义为「勇敢的」
由同根构成，义为「炫技演出」
由同根加意大利最高级后缀构成，义为「太棒了！」

senses.title: A shout of approval
senses.definition: an exclamation of praise, especially after a performance
senses.definitionCN: 表示赞美的呼喊，尤用于演出之后
senses.example: The violinist bowed to the bravos.
senses.exampleCN: 小提琴家在一片喝彩声中鞠躬。
senses.why: The Italian word for brave became the word for calling someone brave, then for applauding anyone.
senses.whyCN: 意大利语「勇敢」一词先变成「称人勇敢」的呼喊，再泛化为对任何人的喝彩。

senses.title: Praise for a woman performer
senses.definition: in Italian grammar, brava is the feminine form of the exclamation
senses.definitionCN: 按意大利语语法，brava 为阴性形式，用于女性演出者
senses.example: The crowd shouted brava to the soprano.
senses.exampleCN: 观众向女高音高喊 brava。
senses.why: Italian grammar follows the person praised, so the shout bends to the performer's gender.
senses.whyCN: 意大利语语法随被赞者的性别变化，呼喊随之变格。

senses.title: A daring hired fighter
senses.definition: a bold sword-for-hire in old Italy, ready for violence
senses.definitionCN: 旧时意大利为钱动剑的亡命打手
senses.example: The duke kept a dozen bravos at his gate.
senses.exampleCN: 公爵门下养着一打亡命徒。
senses.why: The same boldness that earns applause in the theater draws blood in the street.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「胆大」，在剧场赢得喝彩，在街头则见血。

senses.title: Brave, in Italian use
senses.definition: the Italian adjective meaning brave or skillful, kept in English phrases
senses.definitionCN: 意大利语形容词「勇敢的、能干的」，保存在英语固定说法中
senses.example: Bravo! is literally well done! in Italian.
senses.exampleCN: Bravo! 在意大利语中字面即「干得好！」。
senses.why: The exclamation is simply the adjective used as a verdict.
senses.whyCN: 这个感叹不过是把形容词当作评语来用。

senses.title: The letter B in radio codes
senses.definition: the code word for the letter B in the NATO phonetic alphabet
senses.definitionCN: 北约音标字母表中代表字母B的代词
senses.example: The pilot reported Bravo-Two at the bridge.
senses.why: Radio speech needs unmistakable syllables, and bravo was chosen for the letter B.
senses.whyCN: 无线电通话需要绝不混淆的音节，B 的代号选用了 bravo。

senses.title: Bravissimo, praise at its highest
senses.definition: the Italian superlative bravissimo used for outstanding performance
senses.definitionCN: 意大利语最高级 bravissimo，用于特别出色的演出
senses.exampleCN: 欢呼在「太棒了！」中达到顶点。
senses.why: The same root grades upward: bravo, brava, bravissimo.

senses.title: Approval extended beyond the stage
senses.definition: the shout used for any bold success, in sport, debate, or life
senses.definitionCN: 用于体育、辩论或生活中任何大胆成功之举的喝彩
senses.example: Bravo, he said, and shut the argument down.
senses.exampleCN: 「漂亮，」他说，就此终结了那场争论。
senses.why: Once a word salutes the stage, the whole world becomes a stage.
senses.whyCN: 一个词一旦为舞台喝彩，整个世界便都成了舞台。

senses.title: A stamp of danger in fiction
senses.definition: the word as a stock name for thugs in old novels and opera
senses.definitionCN: 旧小说与歌剧中打手角色的固定称名
senses.example: Operatic villains send their bravos to do the dirty work.
senses.exampleCN: 歌剧反派派自己的 bravo 去干脏活。
senses.why: Stock roles keep words alive longer than the profession itself.
senses.whyCN: 固定角色让词语比职业本身活得更久。

intro.en: Bravo is Italian bravo, brave or bold, taken into English both as a cheer and as a name for hired swords.
intro.cn: bravo 是意大利语 bravo（勇敢的、大胆的），进入英语后兼作喝彩语与打手之名。

items.en: The deeper source is disputed: Latin barbarus, foreign and wild, or pravus, crooked, with no settled answer.
items.cn: 更深的来源有争议：或谓拉丁语 barbarus（外邦的、狂野的），或谓 pravus（弯曲的），尚无定论。

items.en: Spanish and Italian both formed bravo meaning bold, wild, or defiant.
items.cn: 西班牙语与意大利语均形成 bravo，意为大胆、狂野、挑衅。

items.en: In Italian, bravo also named the sword-for-hire, the bravo of street violence.
items.cn: 十六世纪意大利语中，bravo 亦指受雇行凶的剑客。

items.en: English borrowed the fighter sense first, through tales of Italian duels.
items.cn: 英语先借入「打手」义，多经意大利决斗故事传入。

items.en: The theatrical cheer entered English with Italian opera, later than the fighter.
items.cn: 剧场喝彩义随意大利歌剧进入英语，晚于「打手」义。

items.en: Modern English keeps the cheer dominant, with the radio code adding a new niche.
items.cn: 现代英语以喝彩义为主，无线电代号又开辟了新场景。

note.en: The brave family is rich in Romance borrowings; sound twins bravo and brava differ by grammar, not spelling chance.
note.cn: brave 词族充满罗曼语借词；bravo 与 brava 之别是语法性的，非拼写偶然。

entries.definitionCN: 情郎；纨绔子；拼写相近，词源不同
掌声；泛指赞许，bravo 是其有声呼喊版

entries.definition: a call for a repeat performance
entries.definitionCN: 返场呼喊；同为剧场呼语
暴徒；与 bravo 的打手义相近

normalIntro.en: One Italian adjective wears three hats: the cheer, the fighter, and the radio letter.
normalIntro.cn: 一个意大利语形容词戴三顶帽子：喝彩语、打手、无线电字母。

normal.en: bravo is Italian for brave, bold.
normal.cn: bravo 在意大利语中意为勇敢、大胆。

normal.en: shouting bravo literally calls the performer brave.
normal.cn: 高喊 bravo 字面上是称演出者「勇敢」。

normal.en: brava is for a woman, bravissimo for the best.
normal.cn: brava 用于女性，bravissimo 为最高级。

normal.en: in old Italy a bravo was a hired sword.
normal.cn: 旧时意大利 bravo 指雇佣剑客。

normal.en: NATO radio uses Bravo for the letter B.
normal.cn: 北约无线电以 Bravo 代字母 B。

abstract.en: A theater's warm roar versus a dark alley's cold blade: one word, two rooms.
abstract.cn: 剧场的暖声浪与暗巷的冷剑锋：一词两室。

abstract.en: Calling someone brave is the shortest review ever written.
abstract.cn: 称人「勇敢」是史上最短的剧评。

abstract.en: B in the sky: pilots spell with this word daily.
abstract.cn: 天上的 B：飞行员每天都在拼这个词。

examples.en: A lone bravo rang out before the hall erupted.
examples.cn: 一声孤零零的「好！」响起，随后全场沸腾。

examples.en: The pamphlet warned citizens about bravos lurking near the palace.
examples.cn: 小册子提醒市民提防在宫殿附近出没的亡命徒。

examples.en: Mission control radioed Bravo-Seven to begin descent.
examples.cn: 任务控制中心呼叫「B-7」开始下降。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不漏」——掌声雷动也「不漏」掉一声「好！」：Bravo 就是那声绝不肯漏的喝彩。

root: 意大利语（与西班牙语）bravo（勇敢的、狂野的）+ 表人/呼语用法；更深拉丁来源有 barbarus 与 pravus 二说，均未成定论。

sensesIntro.en: From the Italian adjective, the word splits into the theater shout, the street fighter, and the radio syllable for B.
sensesIntro.cn: 由意大利语形容词出发，一词分作剧场喝彩、街头打手与代表 B 的无线电音节。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: calling a person brave, whether in applause or in menace
core.cn: 核心意象：称人「勇敢」——或在掌声中，或在威胁里

branches.en: the warm hall: bravo and its superlative
branches.cn: 温热的剧场：bravo 与其最高级

branches.en: the cold street: the hired sword in fact and in fiction
branches.cn: 冰冷的街头：现实与文学中的雇佣剑客

branches.en: the verdict everywhere: brave said of any bold success
branches.cn: 处处皆评语：对一切大胆成功的赞词

intro.en: A single Romance root with Italian suffixes stacked around it for grades and genders.
intro.cn: 单一罗曼语词根，周围叠加意大利语词缀以表级与性。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ancestors are disputed; the family is firmly Romance regardless.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁祖先有争议；但词族归属罗曼语无疑。
